# Viewnear

> Viewnear is a data and AI consultancy and Snowflake Premier and CoCo Preferred Partner serving the Americas (Canada, USA, Mexico, LATAM, and the Caribbean). We take enterprises from data strategy to governed AI in production, built natively on Snowflake.

## Key facts
- Snowflake Premier Partner and Snowflake CoCo Preferred Partner; SnowPro-certified team.
- What we do: data and AI strategy, cloud architecture and data foundation, data engineering and pipelines, analytics and data visualization, Cortex AI and agents, embedded analytics, and capability development.
- Built natively on Snowflake (Openflow, dbt, Snowpark, Horizon Catalog, Cortex, Snowflake CoWork, Apache Iceberg) for one governed foundation.
- Typical time to first production value: 8 to 16 weeks.
- Offices: Austin, TX (USA) and Monterrey, NL (Mexico).
- Contact: contact@viewnear.com
